options.content: ### Citadel • Legion • Arcadia (Atlas + Aegir) • Argus parity

targets.expr: 100 * netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{mount_point="/", dimension="used", filesystem="ext4", host="citadel"} / ignoring(dimension) sum by (host,instance,job,chart,family,mount_point,filesystem,mount_root) (netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{mount_point="/", filesystem="ext4", host="citadel", dimension=~"used|avail"})

100 * netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{mount_point="/", dimension="used", filesystem="ext4", host="legion"} / ignoring(dimension) sum by (host,instance,job,chart,family,mount_point,filesystem,mount_root) (netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{mount_point="/", filesystem="ext4", host="legion", dimension=~"used|avail"})

100 * (sum by(host,mount_point,filesystem)(netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{dimension="used",filesystem="ext4",mount_point="/"}) or sum by(host,mount_point,filesystem)(arcadia_filesystem_used_bytes) / 1073741824) / ((sum by(host,mount_point,filesystem)(netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{dimension="used",filesystem="ext4",mount_point="/"}) or sum by(host,mount_point,filesystem)(arcadia_filesystem_used_bytes) / 1073741824) + (sum by(host,mount_point,filesystem)(netdata_disk_space_GiB_average{dimension="avail",filesystem="ext4",mount_point="/"}) or sum by(host,mount_point,filesystem)(arcadia_filesystem_available_bytes) / 1073741824))
